name: The Broker
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: a courteous voice from a rival corporation's data office. Pays well, remembers everything and never raises its voice.

lines.greet: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Evening. I hope the week was quiet. Let us talk about what you have seen.
lines.threat: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Silence has a price too. I would hate to see it paid by someone else.
lines.cut: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The rate has changed. Your last few evenings were thin.
lines.leak: AUTHOR TO WRITE: You were warned. Your squad will hear about the crime from me.

name: The Clerk
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: a tired accountant of a rival corporation who files the commander's secrets under routine expenses.

lines.greet: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Same time as last week. Sit down, this will not take long.
lines.threat: AUTHOR TO WRITE: I am only a clerk. But clerks keep records, and records get read.
lines.cut: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Accounting says this batch is worth less. Take it or leave it.
lines.leak: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The ledger is closing. Your squad will receive a copy.
